title: eulophia alta
intro: Eulophia alta, commonly known as the orchid tree or the saddle-palm, is a flowering plant species in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia alta include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Eulophia alta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
